Exam Date & Time: 05-May-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - APRIL/MAY 2025  
  SUBJECT: ECE 1071/ECE_1071 - BASIC ELECTRONICS  
  BASIC ELECTRONICS [ECE 1071-PHY]  
Marks: 50                                                                           Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          A Ge diode carries a current of 55mA when it is forward biased with 0.3V at 27°C. If  
  the temperature is increased by 5°C, determine the following:  
  i) Change in diode current.                                                          (4)  
  ii) The forward voltage to maintain the same diode current of 55mA.  
  
1B)          For the circuit shown below in figure Q1B, determine the value of VGS required to  
  $$get VDS = 2.8 V, if µnCox = 250 µA/V2 and VTh = 0.5 V.$$  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
1C)          Consider the half wave rectifier shown in figure Q1C. Explain the operation of the  
  rectifier during positive and negative half cycle. Also, draw waveform of output  
  voltage and output current across the load resistor. Derive the equation of RMS load  
  current.  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
2A)          A full wave rectifier supplying a resistive load is fed from a transformer having turns (4)

ratio of 5:1. The primary voltage of the transformer is 150V at 50Hz. If a capacitor  
  filter is connected across the load, the average load current is 500mA. Determine the  
  rating of capacitor to maintain the ripple factor less than 0.02.  
  
2B)   For the Zener voltage regulator circuit shown in figure Q2B, RS = 100Ω, VZ = 10V,  
  PZM = 1W, PZK = 200mW and RL=1KΩ. Determine the range of values of Vs that  
  will maintain Zener diode in the breakdown region. Also, compute the range of  
  potential difference between cathode and anode terminals of the Zener diode.  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
2C)   Explain the common-mode gain and differential-mode gain of an Op-Amp and  
  provide their expressions in terms of the voltages at the inverting and non-inverting  
  inputs. An Op-Amp has a common mode gain of 100 and CMRR of 60dB. If non-              (3)  
  inverting input voltage is 140 μV and inverting input voltage is 120 μV, calculate the  
  output voltage of OPAMP.  
  
3A)   Implement the following output function using inverting op-amps. Choose feedback  
  resistance as  
  $$Rf=10kΩ.                                                                                (4)$$  
  $$Vo=5V1-V2-3V3+2V4$$  
  
3B)   A 7-bit even parity Hamming code is used to encode a given 4-bit data, d. The  
  codeword received at the receiver is "1111110". Decode the codeword to determine        (3)  
  the transmitted data d, assuming a single error occurred.  
  
3C)   Implement the following logical function using a 4:1 MUX  
  $$F (x, y, z) = \sum  m (2,4,5,7).                                                            (3)$$  
  
4A)   Simplify the following logical expression using K-Map and implement using only  
  NAND gates:                                                                             (4)  
  $$F (A, B, C, D) = \sum m (0, 4, 6, 12) + \sum d (8,14)$$  
  
4B)   Realize a 3-bit down counter using positive edge triggered JK flip flops. Draw the  
  timing diagram for the same.                                                            (3)  
  
4C)   Implement a 4-bit Serial-In Parallel-Out (SIPO) Shift Register. Show the flip-flops  
  and indicate the input Dn, clock signal, and output, Qn for each flip-flop. Write a  
  table which shows the contents of all registers after each clock pulse while shifting   (3)  
  operation is done. The table must show all entries till the data is shifted out  
  completely. Assume 4-bit data as 1010 and data is entered starting from MSB.  
  
5A)   A 200W, 90kHz carrier is amplitude modulated to a depth of 65% by a modulating          (4)  
  signal of 5kHz frequency. Given RL = 1kΩ. Determine the:  
  i) Total power transmitted.  
  ii) Power transmitted in sideband frequencies.  
  iii) Bandwidth of transmitted signal.

iv) Plot the frequency spectrum of the resulting AM wave.  
  
5B)             Draw the block diagram of analog communication system. Explain the operation of  
  each block.                                                                       (3)  
  
5C)             For given binary data 11011010, sketch the ASK, FSK and PSK signals.  
  (3)  
  
  
-----End-----
